subject: Sandbox fuel addendum for overnight threshold validation
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir@novatech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2026 20:02:00 -0700
Subject: Sandbox fuel addendum for overnight threshold validation

Hi Samir —

Quick ask as we prep the overnight throughput soak next week: can we provision an addendum to Novatech's sandbox credits to cover an extra 48-hour window with an expected peak of ~110k tokens/hour (bursting to 140k for short ramps)? The POC team wants to run a late-evening latency sweep to validate p95/p99 under production-like concurrency.

What we need from Redwood:
- Temporary credit top-up: +250k tokens available for a 48-hour window (provisional).
- Start window: UTC 02:00 on Aug 22 for 48 hours (Novatech local night).
- Soft cap alerting at 180k tokens consumed so we can throttle if needed.

Attached a short traffic plan and a dashboard snapshot. If you can approve the addendum I will route this for finance/billing sign-off and provide a DocuSign link if any small T&Cs are required.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround, this run is the last validation before their internal demo.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0168

Attachment: novatech-traffic-plan.csv (CSV; 1.2 KB)
Attachment: dashboard-usage-snapshot.png (PNG; 48 KB)

From: Samir Khan <samir@novatech.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2026 22:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sandbox fuel addendum for overnight threshold validation

Thanks Karthik — this looks good and helps our test plan. A couple quick clarifications before we lock times:  

1) Can we confirm whether the requested tokens are per-project or per-account? We have two concurrent test agents hitting separate endpoints and want to ensure the capacity isn't pooled unexpectedly.
2) On the soft cap alerting: can you send the channel (email/slack) and the alert format so our engineers can automate throttling?

If those are in place we are comfortable with the 02:00 UTC start for Aug 22. I can also push the window by an hour if it helps ops.

—Samir
Samir Khan
Director, Platform Engineering | Novatech
samir@novatech.com

Karthik / Marissa —

Finance here. Reviewed the traffic plan and the ask; provisional approval provided under these conditions:
- Temporary grant: +275,000 tokens for 48 hours (start window adjustable ±2 hours).
- Consumption hard cap: 300,000 tokens (automatic cutoff to prevent bill surprises).
- Alerting: Samir will receive email alerts at 60% / 80% / 95% consumption; ops should be prepared to back off at 80%.
- Billing notes: chargeable overage beyond the hard cap, but we expect none; drop me a note if you want an internal invoice waived for the POC.

I'll route the approval to billing and create the short amendment record (deal: NV-POC-2026-0820). Please confirm start window so we can enable the policy.

—Ben Carter

ben_carter@redwood.com

Samir — great, we have provisional approval from finance. Summary/next steps:

- Grant: +275k tokens for a 48-hour window.
- Hard cap: 300k tokens (auto-cutoff).
- Soft alerts: email to poc-team@novatech.com at 60% / 80% / 95% consumption (we will also post to your ops Slack if you share the webhook).
- Start: Aug 22 02:00 UTC (you said ±1 hour is fine — confirm if you want 03:00 UTC).

I'll send the short amendment and billing link after you confirm the start hour. If you'd like us to enable a temporary additional concurrency lane (to spread load across two endpoints) say the word and we'll allocate it inside the sandbox for the window.

Thanks — excited to get this over the finish line for your demo.

Best,
Karthik
